name: stack-ablation
description: Frozen OHLCV dataset and chronological splits for STACK causal component ablation.

validation.purpose: Confirm train/val direction agreement. Never inspect to pick params.

holdout.purpose: Final untouched evaluation, executed exactly once after a configuration wins validation.

source_file_asymmetry.description: The downloaded datasets end on different dates per timeframe. Both files extend past the common evaluation end; only complete UTC days are evaluated.

15m.treatment: Partial-day Aug 31 02:30 bar sits OUTSIDE the holdout window (start_inclusive=2026-01-01, end_exclusive=2026-08-31). It is never used for evaluation.

1h.treatment: 1h bars from 2026-08-31 00:00 through 2026-09-02 12:00 sit OUTSIDE the common evaluation end_exclusive. They are never used for evaluation; the context timeframe is sliced with the same end_exclusive as the entry timeframe.

notes: Splits use half-open UTC intervals: [start_inclusive, end_exclusive). A bar with date == end_exclusive is EXCLUDED. This matches Freqtrade timerange semantics where '20260101-' is interpreted as 2026-01-01 00:00 inclusive forward, never back into the prior day.
Splits are disjoint and chronologically ordered: train.end_exclusive == validation.start_inclusive and validation.end_exclusive == holdout.start_inclusive (touching, not overlapping).

holdout: 2026-01-01 (inclusive) to 2026-08-31 (exclusive) -> bars from 2026-01-01 00:00 through 2026-08-30 23:45 (15m) / 2026-08-30 23:00 (1h). Partial-day Aug 31 02:30 (15m) and Sep 1 / Sep 2 (1h) bars are excluded.
Fee 0.0015 = 15 bps per side, applied symmetrically on entry and exit.
Data is immutable: any regeneration must update sha256 and bump schema_version.
